title: Climbing Stairs
statement: You climb a staircase of n steps, taking either 1 or 2 steps at a time. Return how many distinct ways there are to reach the top.
hints: The last move onto step n came either from step n-1 or from step n-2.
So ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2). These are the Fibonacci numbers.
You only ever need the last two values, so two integers suffice; no array required.
